No export scaling.", "simplification": "Meaning-specific reconstruction with original 1.4 mm strokes and freshly sampled 1.2 mm Index dots. Left hand viewed from the palm, fingertips upward and thumb on page-left. All 27 bones remain individually outlined: eight named carpals, five metacarpals and fourteen phalanges. Four fingers retain three phalanges each; the thumb retains two. The hand is re-laid out with wider capsule bones, expanded joint gaps and independently shortened fingers; the middle finger remains longest and little finger shorter. The wrist is explicitly exploded: the pisiform is moved beside the ulnar triquetrum instead of overlapping it. Relative lengths and joint surfaces are not measurements; no radius or ulna is added.", "canvas_mm": [170, 200]}, "teaching": "Left hand viewed from the palm, fingertips upward and thumb on page-left. All 27 bones remain individually outlined: eight named carpals, five metacarpals and fourteen phalanges. Four fingers retain three phalanges each; the thumb retains two. The hand is re-laid out with wider capsule bones, expanded joint gaps and independently shortened fingers; the middle finger remains longest and little finger shorter. The wrist is explicitly exploded: the pisiform is moved beside the ulnar triquetrum instead of overlapping it. Relative lengths and joint surfaces are not measurements; no radius or ulna is added. External object-name and viewpoint key required; physical tactile and learner evaluation remain pending.
